svg.title: Auditing AI SNAP Applications: Filer and Reader Pipeline
svg.desc: Three-panel teaser. Panel a shows the Filer study and Reader study built from FY2024 SNAP QC records (8.5% of omitted-income error dollars found in the case record). Panel b shows that when no wage record is present, a Number required form causes 71 of 72 filings to enter $0 plus 1 invalid (0/72 flagged by rule check), whereas an "Unknown" allowed form produces 41 blank and 31 schema-invalid filings (72/72 flagged), and after rejection qwen3.5 invents a wage on 13/24 cases; stale pay stubs trigger 0/144 rule-check flags under both forms. Panel c compares AI reader flag rates when income is omitted versus when there is no income, showing the same ambiguous bank deposit drives high error-group flagging alongside high false-flagging.

g.text: Stale pay stub: check flags 0/144 under both forms
